assets/vo/s01-1dffecd9.mp3: What's an embedding? And why does AI need them?
assets/vo/s02-cdd0dfc5.mp3: To a computer, dog and puppy look nothing alike.
assets/vo/s02-4997c3ba.mp3: But they mean almost the same thing.
assets/vo/s03-3d28c757.mp3: That's where an embedding model comes in.
assets/vo/s03-8513ec71.mp3: It's an AI trained on huge amounts of text.
assets/vo/s03-c85ffe28.mp3: It learned that dog and puppy fit into the same kinds of sentences.
assets/vo/s04-d69fecce.mp3: Give it a word, and it turns the meaning into a list of numbers.
assets/vo/s04-7f4aebd6.mp3: That whole list is the embedding.
assets/vo/s05-9e042223.mp3: So what do the numbers mean?
assets/vo/s05-8e9e50e5.mp3: Each one is a score for some quality. Like: is it an animal? Is it food?
assets/vo/s05-946a7b53.mp3: But nobody picked these. The model learned them, so we can't read them one by one.
assets/vo/s05-08f9f236.mp3: Together, they're a fingerprint for meaning.
assets/vo/s06-2537940b.mp3: Is it exact? No. It's the model's best guess.
assets/vo/s06-60d0d2ed.mp3: But similar meanings get similar fingerprints.
assets/vo/s07-b25dc560.mp3: Squash all those numbers down to two, and each word gets a spot on a map.
assets/vo/s07-9385d5c4.mp3: Dog and puppy are neighbours. Pizza? Way over here.
assets/vo/s08-74beffc6.mp3: A computer can score how close two spots are.
assets/vo/s08-82932496.mp3: Dog and puppy: point eight. Dog and pizza: point three five.
assets/vo/s08-f2fabb38.mp3: Pizza isn't zero, because scores are fuzzy. What matters is which is closest.
assets/vo/s09-a1b6cbc6.mp3: That score has a name: cosine similarity.
assets/vo/s09-a627ccc8.mp3: Picture each embedding as an arrow. It measures the angle between two arrows.
assets/vo/s09-a15a325e.mp3: Dog and puppy: a small angle, so a high score.
assets/vo/s09-1bf8dd73.mp3: Dog and pizza: a wider angle, so a lower score.
assets/vo/s09-6891aee6.mp3: Pointing the same way scores one. At a right angle, zero.
assets/vo/s10-5599cb4f.mp3: Keyword search spots the word bike, and gets it wrong.
assets/vo/s10-9e01821b.mp3: Embedding search matches the meaning, and finds the fix.
assets/vo/s11-def10c97.mp3: Where do embeddings live? In a database.
assets/vo/s11-9ab39eb5.mp3: Take a team handbook and split it into chunks.
assets/vo/s11-199c6a83.mp3: Each row stores a chunk and its numbers.
assets/vo/s12-6c54de31.mp3: A vector database searches those numbers by closeness.
assets/vo/s12-f6efaf4d.mp3: Ask a question, and it becomes numbers too.
assets/vo/s12-dcab77e0.mp3: The database finds the nearest chunk.
assets/vo/s13-e68ed91f.mp3: That chunk goes to Claude, along with your question.
assets/vo/s13-342a6faa.mp3: So Claude answers from the right page.
assets/vo/s14-6ccb7d8f.mp3: So that's embeddings: meaning, turned into numbers.
